---
title: "NYC Restaurant Inspections"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)

data("rest_inspec")

inspections_df =
  rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C"),
    boro != "0",
    !is.na(score)
  ) |>
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(camis, dba, boro, cuisine_description, inspection_date,
         score, grade, latitude, longitude)
```

Column {data-width=600}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Manhattan inspection scores by location (random sample of 3,000 inspections)

```{r}
set.seed(8105)

inspections_df |>
  filter(boro == "Manhattan", latitude > 40, longitude < -73) |>
  sample_n(3000) |>
  mutate(text_label = str_c(dba, "\nCuisine: ", cuisine_description,
                            "\nScore: ", score, "\nGrade: ", grade)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~longitude, y = ~latitude, color = ~score, text = ~text_label,
    type = "scatter", mode = "markers", alpha = 0.6,
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  colorbar(title = "Score") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Longitude"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Latitude"),
    font = list(size = 13)
  )
```

Column {data-width=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Inspection score distribution by borough (higher score = more violations)

```{r}
inspections_df |>
  mutate(boro = fct_infreq(boro)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~boro, y = ~score, color = ~boro,
    type = "box", colors = "viridis"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Borough"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Inspection score"),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    font = list(size = 13)
  )
```

### Share of grade A inspections for the 10 most inspected cuisines

```{r}
inspections_df |>
  mutate(cuisine_description = recode(
    cuisine_description,
    "Latin (Cuban, Dominican, Puerto Rican, South & Central American)" = "Latin"
  )) |>
  group_by(cuisine_description) |>
  summarize(
    n_inspections = n(),
    pct_a = mean(grade == "A") * 100
  ) |>
  slice_max(n_inspections, n = 10) |>
  mutate(cuisine_description = fct_reorder(cuisine_description, pct_a)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~pct_a, y = ~cuisine_description, type = "bar",
    orientation = "h", marker = list(color = "#2c7fb8"),
    text = ~str_c(round(pct_a, 1), "% A of ", n_inspections, " inspections"),
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Percent of inspections graded A"),
    yaxis = list(title = ""),
    font = list(size = 13)
  )
```
